blind_spots.blind_spot: Core marketed product (Q Sentinel/The Q) is a cloud-connected, C4I-console-tied venue security kiosk, and this IIoT/cloud architecture is the base the tactical spectrum classifier is built from
blind_spots.operator_reality: A spectrum classifier meant for 'Agile Spectrum Superiority' in contested RF environments needs to run denied/degraded from any cloud or centralized command center — the opposite of a kiosk-and-console architecture designed for venue Wi-Fi and staffed control rooms
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: site describes the underlying SNIM AI platform generically as reusable across 'commercial and government organizations' without addressing what changes when the deployment context loses connectivity
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Q Sentinel integrates a suite of technologies and services to handle everything secure entry and intelligent screening to real-time command-and-control

blind_spots.blind_spot: Only open hire is a cloud SaaS full-stack/DevOps engineer while the funded DoD product is a tactical spectrum classifier
blind_spots.operator_reality: Fielding an RF/EW-adjacent tactical AI system on Air Force hardware requires embedded/edge engineering, not cloud SaaS skills — the hiring signal suggests the company is still building for its commercial venue-security business, not the defense transition
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: TASCS SBIR win (2024) has not visibly changed the hiring profile
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Contract Software Engineer – Cloud SaaS (Full Stack + Cloud/DevOps)

blind_spots.blind_spot: SNIM AI is described as sustaining performance 'amid the challenging realities of their missions' with no SWaP-C specifics
blind_spots.operator_reality: A tactical spectrum classifier riding on a radio or platform has a real power/weight/compute budget; 'challenging realities' as a phrase does no work — the company has not shown it has translated venue-kiosk-scale compute into an edge-deployable footprint
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: language stays at the mission-generic level across both commercial and defense product descriptions
blind_spots.evidence_quote: SNIM® AI maintains the ongoing performance of autonomous systems AI amid the challenging realities of their missions

opener_hook: Your AFWERX Direct-to-Phase-II SBIR (2024) is adapting SNIM AI from venue-entry screening to Tactical AI Spectrum Classification — what's different about the SWaP-C budget going from a kiosk to a radio?
what_they_do: Builds SNIM AI, an autonomous-systems AI platform originally productized as Q Sentinel/The Q for venue entry security screening, now being adapted under an AFWERX SBIR into a Tactical AI Spectrum Classifier System for the Air Force.
